expected.evidence_contract: Qualified exact-byte notice coverage for the checked root and explicit TFM/all-root-entry scope. Admitted complete dependency and asset captures, prevalidated whole-subject obligation reviews, and exhaustive reviewed mappings are trust boundaries, not authenticated by hashes or references. No legal advice, LP-03 acceptability, build/source correspondence, ownership, vulnerability/support conclusion, or proof that the supplied obligation review is legally correct.
expected.missing_fact: An explicit exact-root and assessment scope is missing.

cases.rationale: Exact root bytes without checked notice-coverage evidence cannot establish notice compliance.
